content.body: When you are injured your screen will flash red to indicate that you have been wounded; if you are killed you will see your body in the "Death Cam". Your energy and health status are indicated by the red (health) and green (energy) bars. With low health or energy, you may lose the ability to run or use the joystick. The Stance Indicator in the lower left corner lets you know if you are crewing a vehicle, standing, crouching, or laying prone.
